```{=html}
<div id="hwm-root"></div>
<style>
  #hwm-root { max-width:780px; margin:0 auto; padding:4px 0; color:#1f2933; text-align:left;
                font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif; font-size:16px; line-height:1.3; }
  #hwm-root .hwm-bar { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:10px; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; }
  #hwm-root .hwm-seg { display:inline-flex; background:#eef1f4; border-radius:9px; padding:3px; }
  #hwm-root .hwm-seg button { border:0; margin:0; background:transparent; padding:6px 13px; border-radius:7px; cursor:pointer;
                font-family:inherit; font-size:15px; line-height:1.2; color:#7b8794; text-transform:none; letter-spacing:normal;
                transition:background .25s, color .25s, box-shadow .25s; }
  #hwm-root .hwm-seg button.hwm-on { background:#ffffff; color:#1f2933; box-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.14); }
  #hwm-root .hwm-cap { font-size:14px; color:#7b8794; margin:8px 2px 0; min-height:20px; }
  #hwm-root svg { width:100%; height:auto; display:block; margin:0; max-height:none; }
  #hwm-root .hwm-ax { transition:opacity .6s ease; }
  #hwm-root .hwm-tick { font-size:13px; fill:#7b8794; }
  #hwm-root .hwm-lab { font-size:14px; fill:#1f2933; }
  #hwm-root .hwm-leg { font-size:13px; fill:#1f2933; transition:opacity .4s; }
</style>

50, 60, 70, 80, 90, 100, 110], "xlab": "Height (cm)", "ylab": "Weight (kg)", "xshort": "height", "yshort": "weight", "groups": [{"key": "W", "label": "Women", "color": "#d53f8c"}, {"key": "M", "label": "Men", "color": "#2b6cb0"}], "capJoint": "Joint distribution: each dot is one student (height, weight)", "capX": "Empirical marginal of height: every dot falls onto the x-axis", "capY": "Empirical marginal of weight: every dot falls onto the y-axis"};
  const P = 'hwm', CFG = CFG_P;
  const root = document.getElementById(P + '-root');
  const W = 760, H = 470, m = { l: 62, r: 20, t: 16, b: 54 };
  const pw = W - m.l - m.r, ph = H - m.t - m.b;
  const [x0, x1] = CFG.xdom, [y0, y1] = CFG.ydom;
  const sx = v => m.l + (v - x0) / (x1 - x0) * pw;
  const sy = v => m.t + ph - (v - y0) / (y1 - y0) * ph;
  const NS = 'http://www.w3.org/2000/svg';
  const el = (t, a, p) => { const e = document.createElementNS(NS, t);
    for (const k in a) e.setAttribute(k, a[k]); if (p) p.appendChild(e); return e; };

  // ---------- controls ----------
  const bar = document.createElement('div'); bar.className = P + '-bar'; root.appendChild(bar);
  function seg(opts, init, cb) {
    const s = document.createElement('div'); s.className = P + '-seg'; const bs = {};
    opts.forEach(([k, l]) => {
      const b = document.createElement('button'); b.textContent = l;
      b.onclick = () => { if (b.classList.contains(P + '-on')) return; for (const kk in bs) bs[kk].classList.toggle(P + '-on', kk === k); cb(k); };
      bs[k] = b; s.appendChild(b);
    });
    bs[init].classList.add(P + '-on'); bar.appendChild(s);
  }
  let mode = 'joint', filt = 'all';
  seg([['joint', 'Joint'], ['mx', 'Marginal of ' + CFG.xshort], ['my', 'Marginal of ' + CFG.yshort]],
      'joint', k => { mode = k; update(); });
  if (CFG.groups) seg([['all', 'All'], ...CFG.groups.map(g => [g.key, g.label])],
      'all', k => { filt = k; update(); });
  const cap = document.createElement('div'); cap.className = P + '-cap'; root.appendChild(cap);

  // ---------- axes ----------
  const svg = el('svg', { viewBox: `0 0 ${W} ${H}`, role: 'img', 'aria-label': CFG.title }, root);
  const xAx = el('g', { class: P + '-ax' }, svg), yAx = el('g', { class: P + '-ax' }, svg);
  CFG.yticks.forEach(v => {
    el('line', { x1: m.l, x2: m.l + pw, y1: sy(v), y2: sy(v), stroke: '#edf0f3' }, yAx);
    el('text', { x: m.l - 10, y: sy(v) + 4.5, 'text-anchor': 'end', class: P + '-tick' }, yAx).textContent = v;
  });
  CFG.xticks.forEach(v => {
    el('line', { x1: sx(v), x2: sx(v), y1: m.t, y2: m.t + ph, stroke: '#edf0f3' }, xAx);
    el('text', { x: sx(v), y: m.t + ph + 22, 'text-anchor': 'middle', class: P + '-tick' }, xAx).textContent = v;
  });
  el('text', { x: m.l + pw / 2, y: H - 8, 'text-anchor': 'middle', class: P + '-lab' }, xAx).textContent = CFG.xlab;
  el('text', { x: 16, y: m.t + ph / 2, 'text-anchor': 'middle', class: P + '-lab',
               transform: `rotate(-90 16 ${m.t + ph / 2})` }, yAx).textContent = CFG.ylab;
  el('line', { x1: m.l, x2: m.l + pw, y1: m.t + ph, y2: m.t + ph, stroke: '#9aa5b1' }, svg);
  el('line', { x1: m.l, x2: m.l, y1: m.t, y2: m.t + ph, stroke: '#9aa5b1' }, svg);

  // legend (groups only)
  const legItems = {};
  if (CFG.groups) CFG.groups.forEach((g, i) => {
    const gg = el('g', { class: P + '-leg', transform: `translate(${m.l + pw - 150 + i * 80}, ${m.t + 6})` }, svg);
    el('circle', { cx: 0, cy: 0, r: 5, fill: g.color }, gg);
    el('text', { x: 10, y: 4.5 }, gg).textContent = g.label;
    legItems[g.key] = gg;
  });

  // ---------- dots (constant size throughout) ----------
  const R = CFG.r || 4.3, OP = 0.82;
  const G = 0.0011;                 // gravity, px / ms^2
  const dotsG = el('g', {}, svg);
  const color = d => CFG.groups ? CFG.groups.find(g => g.key === d.g).color : CFG.color;
  const pts = CFG.data.map(d => ({ g: d.g, dx: d.x, dy: d.y,
    c: el('circle', { r: R, fill: color(d), stroke: '#fff', 'stroke-width': 0.8, opacity: 0 }, dotsG),
    x: sx(d.x), y: sy(d.y), op: 0, segs: [], pile: null }));
  const active = p => filt === 'all' || p.g === filt;
  const home = p => ({ x: sx(p.dx), y: sy(p.dy) });

  // pile frame: v = lateral coordinate, u = height above the "floor" (the axis the dots fall onto)
  const toVU = (dim, x, y) => dim === 'x' ? { v: x, u: m.t + ph - y } : { v: y, u: x - m.l };
  const toXY = (dim, v, u) => dim === 'x' ? { x: v, y: m.t + ph - u } : { x: m.l + u, y: v };

  // drop one disk at lateral position v0 onto the floor / existing disks; it may roll a little sideways into a lower spot
  function deposit(v0, placed, vTrue = v0, maxDrift = 3 * R) {
    const restU = v => { let u = R;
      for (const q of placed) { const dv = v - q.v; if (dv > -2 * R && dv < 2 * R) u = Math.max(u, q.u + Math.sqrt(4 * R * R - dv * dv)); }
      return u; };
    let best = null;
    for (let dl = -1.6 * R; dl <= 1.6 * R; dl += 0.25) {
      if (Math.abs(v0 + dl - vTrue) > maxDrift) continue;        // never let a dot wander far from its true value
      const u = restU(v0 + dl), cost = u + 0.3 * Math.abs(dl);
      if (!best || cost < best.cost) best = { v: v0 + dl, u, cost };
    }
    return best;
  }
  // build a pile from the given dots, dropped in order of current height above the floor (lowest lands first).
  // Then re-release the settled pile a few times until it stops changing, so the first drop already lands in its final, smooth shape.
  function buildPile(dim, list, placed, passes = 15) {
    const base = placed.slice();
    const orig = new Map(list.map(p => [p, toVU(dim, p.x, p.y)]));   // true data position: rolling is always measured from here
    let start = orig;
    for (let k = 0; k < passes; k++) {
      const pl = base.slice();
      list.slice().sort((a, b) => start.get(a).u - start.get(b).u).forEach(p => {
        const r = deposit(start.get(p).v, pl, orig.get(p).v); pl.push(r); p.pile = { v: r.v, u: r.u };
      });
      const moved = k === 0 ? Infinity : list.reduce((s, p) => s + Math.abs(p.pile.v - start.get(p).v) + Math.abs(p.pile.u - start.get(p).u), 0);
      start = new Map(list.map(p => [p, p.pile]));
      if (moved < 0.5) break;
    }
    list.forEach(p => placed.push({ v: p.pile.v, u: p.pile.u }));
  }
  // ---------- animation segments ----------
  const ease = u => u < 0.5 ? 4 * u * u * u : 1 - Math.pow(-2 * u + 2, 3) / 2;
  const smooth = u => u * u * (3 - 2 * u);
  let clock = 0, raf = null;
  // each segment: {t0, dur, kind, ...}; positions evaluated relative to the segment start
  function addFall(p, dim, from, to, t0) {
    const a = toVU(dim, from.x, from.y), b = toVU(dim, to.x, to.y), D = Math.max(0, a.u - b.u);
    const T = Math.max(60, Math.sqrt(2 * D / G));
    p.segs.push({ t0, dur: T, kind: 'fall', dim, a, b, D });
    const amp = Math.min(3.5, 0.9 * G * T * 3);             // tiny bounce scaled by impact speed
    p.segs.push({ t0: t0 + T, dur: 170, kind: 'bounce', dim, b, amp });
    return t0 + T + 170;
  }
  function addMove(p, from, to, t0, dur) { p.segs.push({ t0, dur, kind: 'move', from, to }); return t0 + dur; }
  function addFade(p, o0, o1, t0, dur) { p.segs.push({ t0, dur, kind: 'fade', o0, o1 }); }

  function evalP(p, t) {
    for (const s of p.segs) {
      if (t < s.t0) continue;
      const u = Math.min(1, (t - s.t0) / s.dur);
      if (s.kind === 'fade') { p.op = s.o0 + (s.o1 - s.o0) * u; continue; }
      let q;
      if (s.kind === 'move') { const k = ease(u); q = { x: s.from.x + (s.to.x - s.from.x) * k, y: s.from.y + (s.to.y - s.from.y) * k }; }
      else if (s.kind === 'fall') {

        const roll = smooth(Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (u - 0.65) / 0.35)));   // sideways roll only at the end of the fall
        q = toXY(s.dim, s.a.v + (s.b.v - s.a.v) * roll, s.a.u - fallen);

    for (const p of pts) {

      p.c.setAttribute('cx', p.x.toFixed(2)); p.c.setAttribute('cy', p.y.toFixed(2)); p.c.setAttribute('opacity', p.op.toFixed(3));
    }

  }

  let shown = 'joint';                      // what the dots currently form
  function update(changed) {
    start();
    const n = pts.filter(active).length;
    cap.textContent = (mode === 'joint' ? CFG.capJoint : mode === 'mx' ? CFG.capX : CFG.capY) + `   ·   n = ${n}`;
    xAx.style.opacity = mode === 'my' ? 0 : 1;
    yAx.style.opacity = mode === 'mx' ? 0 : 1;
    for (const k in legItems) legItems[k].style.opacity = (filt === 'all' || filt === k) ? 1 : 0.25;

    // fades for filter changes
    const entering = [], leaving = [];
    pts.forEach(p => {
      const on = active(p), vis = p.op > 0.01;
      if (on && !vis) entering.push(p);
      if (!on && vis) { leaving.push(p); addFade(p, p.op, 0, 0, 350); p.pile = null; }
    });

    if (mode === 'joint') {
      pts.filter(active).forEach(p => {
        p.pile = null;
        if (entering.includes(p)) { p.x = home(p).x; p.y = home(p).y; addFade(p, 0, OP, 0, 400); }
        else addMove(p, { x: p.x, y: p.y }, home(p), Math.random() * 180, 850);
      });

    }

    const dim = mode === 'mx' ? 'x' : 'y';
    const act = pts.filter(active);
    if (shown !== mode) {
      // lift everything back to its scatter position first (if not already there), then let gravity act
      const lift = shown === 'joint' ? 0 : 750;
      act.forEach(p => {
        p.pile = null;
        if (entering.includes(p)) { p.x = home(p).x; p.y = home(p).y; addFade(p, 0, OP, 0, 300); }
        else if (lift) addMove(p, { x: p.x, y: p.y }, home(p), Math.random() * 120, lift - 120);
      });
      const placed = []; const src = act.map(p => ({ p, x: home(p).x, y: home(p).y }));
      // pile computed from scatter positions
      src.forEach(o => { o.p._x = o.p.x; o.p._y = o.p.y; o.p.x = o.x; o.p.y = o.y; });
      buildPile(dim, act, placed);
      src.forEach(o => { o.p.x = o.p._x; o.p.y = o.p._y; });
      act.forEach(p => addFall(p, dim, home(p), toXY(dim, p.pile.v, p.pile.u), lift + 150 + Math.random() * 120));
    } else {
      // same marginal, filter changed: survivors re-settle downward, newcomers appear at their scatter spot and fall on top
      const stay = act.filter(p => !entering.includes(p));
      const placed = []; const t0 = leaving.length ? 300 : 0;
      buildPile(dim, stay, placed);
      stay.forEach(p => {
        const to = toXY(dim, p.pile.v, p.pile.u), cur = toVU(dim, p.x, p.y);
        if (cur.u - p.pile.u > 0.5) addFall(p, dim, { x: p.x, y: p.y }, to, t0 + Math.random() * 80);
        else if (Math.hypot(to.x - p.x, to.y - p.y) > 0.5) addMove(p, { x: p.x, y: p.y }, to, t0, 400);
      });
      entering.forEach(p => { p.x = home(p).x; p.y = home(p).y; addFade(p, 0, OP, t0, 300); });
      buildPile(dim, entering.map(p => p), placed);
      entering.forEach(p => addFall(p, dim, home(p), toXY(dim, p.pile.v, p.pile.u), t0 + 350 + Math.random() * 120));
    }
    shown = mode;
  }
  update();
})();
</script>
```

```{=html}
  }
  // ---------- animation segments ----------
  const ease = u => u < 0.5 ? 4 * u * u * u : 1 - Math.pow(-2 * u + 2, 3) / 2;
  const smooth = u => u * u * (3 - 2 * u);
  let clock = 0, raf = null;
  // each segment: {t0, dur, kind, ...}; positions evaluated relative to the segment start
  function addFall(p, dim, from, to, t0) {
    const a = toVU(dim, from.x, from.y), b = toVU(dim, to.x, to.y), D = Math.max(0, a.u - b.u);
    const T = Math.max(60, Math.sqrt(2 * D / G));
    p.segs.push({ t0, dur: T, kind: 'fall', dim, a, b, D });
    const amp = Math.min(3.5, 0.9 * G * T * 3);             // tiny bounce scaled by impact speed
    p.segs.push({ t0: t0 + T, dur: 170, kind: 'bounce', dim, b, amp });
    return t0 + T + 170;
  }
  function addMove(p, from, to, t0, dur) { p.segs.push({ t0, dur, kind: 'move', from, to }); return t0 + dur; }
  function addFade(p, o0, o1, t0, dur) { p.segs.push({ t0, dur, kind: 'fade', o0, o1 }); }

  function evalP(p, t) {
    for (const s of p.segs) {
      if (t < s.t0) continue;
      const u = Math.min(1, (t - s.t0) / s.dur);
      if (s.kind === 'fade') { p.op = s.o0 + (s.o1 - s.o0) * u; continue; }
      let q;
      if (s.kind === 'move') { const k = ease(u); q = { x: s.from.x + (s.to.x - s.from.x) * k, y: s.from.y + (s.to.y - s.from.y) * k }; }
      else if (s.kind === 'fall') {
        const tt = u * s.dur, fallen = Math.min(s.D, 0.5 * G * tt * tt);
        const roll = smooth(Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (u - 0.65) / 0.35)));   // sideways roll only at the end of the fall
        q = toXY(s.dim, s.a.v + (s.b.v - s.a.v) * roll, s.a.u - fallen);
      } else { q = toXY(s.dim, s.b.v, s.b.u + s.amp * Math.sin(Math.PI * u)); }
      p.x = q.x; p.y = q.y;
    }
  }
  function tick(now) {
    if (!clock) clock = now;
    const t = now - clock; let busy = false;
    for (const p of pts) {
      evalP(p, t);
      if (p.segs.some(s => t < s.t0 + s.dur)) busy = true;
      p.c.setAttribute('cx', p.x.toFixed(2)); p.c.setAttribute('cy', p.y.toFixed(2)); p.c.setAttribute('opacity', p.op.toFixed(3));
    }
    raf = busy ? requestAnimationFrame(tick) : null;
  }
  function start() {                       // freeze current state, start a fresh timeline
    pts.forEach(p => { p.segs = []; });
    clock = 0; if (!raf) raf = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  }

  // ---------- state transitions ----------
  let shown = 'joint';                      // what the dots currently form
  function update(changed) {
    start();
    const n = pts.filter(active).length;
    cap.textContent = (mode === 'joint' ? CFG.capJoint : mode === 'mx' ? CFG.capX : CFG.capY) + `   ·   n = ${n}`;
    xAx.style.opacity = mode === 'my' ? 0 : 1;
    yAx.style.opacity = mode === 'mx' ? 0 : 1;
    for (const k in legItems) legItems[k].style.opacity = (filt === 'all' || filt === k) ? 1 : 0.25;

    // fades for filter changes
    const entering = [], leaving = [];
    pts.forEach(p => {
      const on = active(p), vis = p.op > 0.01;
      if (on && !vis) entering.push(p);
      if (!on && vis) { leaving.push(p); addFade(p, p.op, 0, 0, 350); p.pile = null; }
    });

    if (mode === 'joint') {
      pts.filter(active).forEach(p => {
        p.pile = null;
        if (entering.includes(p)) { p.x = home(p).x; p.y = home(p).y; addFade(p, 0, OP, 0, 400); }
        else addMove(p, { x: p.x, y: p.y }, home(p), Math.random() * 180, 850);
      });
      shown = 'joint'; return;
    }

    const dim = mode === 'mx' ? 'x' : 'y';
    const act = pts.filter(active);
    if (shown !== mode) {
      // lift everything back to its scatter position first (if not already there), then let gravity act
      const lift = shown === 'joint' ? 0 : 750;
      act.forEach(p => {
        p.pile = null;
        if (entering.includes(p)) { p.x = home(p).x; p.y = home(p).y; addFade(p, 0, OP, 0, 300); }
        else if (lift) addMove(p, { x: p.x, y: p.y }, home(p), Math.random() * 120, lift - 120);
      });
      const placed = []; const src = act.map(p => ({ p, x: home(p).x, y: home(p).y }));
      // pile computed from scatter positions
      src.forEach(o => { o.p._x = o.p.x; o.p._y = o.p.y; o.p.x = o.x; o.p.y = o.y; });
      buildPile(dim, act, placed);
      src.forEach(o => { o.p.x = o.p._x; o.p.y = o.p._y; });
      act.forEach(p => addFall(p, dim, home(p), toXY(dim, p.pile.v, p.pile.u), lift + 150 + Math.random() * 120));
    } else {
      // same marginal, filter changed: survivors re-settle downward, newcomers appear at their scatter spot and fall on top
      const stay = act.filter(p => !entering.includes(p));
      const placed = []; const t0 = leaving.length ? 300 : 0;
      buildPile(dim, stay, placed);
      stay.forEach(p => {
        const to = toXY(dim, p.pile.v, p.pile.u), cur = toVU(dim, p.x, p.y);
        if (cur.u - p.pile.u > 0.5) addFall(p, dim, { x: p.x, y: p.y }, to, t0 + Math.random() * 80);
        else if (Math.hypot(to.x - p.x, to.y - p.y) > 0.5) addMove(p, { x: p.x, y: p.y }, to, t0, 400);
      });
      entering.forEach(p => { p.x = home(p).x; p.y = home(p).y; addFade(p, 0, OP, t0, 300); });
      buildPile(dim, entering.map(p => p), placed);
      entering.forEach(p => addFall(p, dim, home(p), toXY(dim, p.pile.v, p.pile.u), t0 + 350 + Math.random() * 120));
    }
    shown = mode;
  }
  update();
})();
</script>
```
